newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Rugby union-Popplewell fit for England.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Popplewell fit for England.

text.p: Ireland prop forward Nick Popplewell has been passed fit to play against England in Saturday's Five Nations championship game at Lansdowne Road.
"We have no fitness problems at all. Nick will play," said Ireland team manager Pat Whelan as his squad arrived in Dublin from Limerick, where they have been based since the early part of the week.
Popplewell was under treatment for a hamstring strain but came through a squad training session on Thursday morning.
Whelan said centre Jonathan Bell and flanker David Corkery, nursing a rib injury and a broken finger respectively, would also play.
